source.what: The informant lines («Записано отъ …») that close each item of Bogoras 1900, «Матеріалы», Часть I, Sections I and II
source.read_from: every line off its own leaf, scans at 600 dpi; the text layer located them and was overruled wherever the scan disagreed
source.covers: 138 lines on 133 items. Section III (nos. 145-168) names no narrator: its footnote to no. 145 (1-444) says those retellings were taken down in the first half of 1896 from the words of various interpreters
caveats: A record is one printed line, on the leaf it is printed on; `folio` is that leaf's printed folio, read from its running head (null where the head was unreadable). The record is a folio witness for its leaf.

`on_leaf` is the record's place among the informant lines printed on its leaf, counted down the page: two items can close on one leaf with identical lines (nos. 41 and 42 on 1-198), and two songs of no. 46 print the same line, so the line's text does not identify it.
`printed` is the line as set, pre-reform orthography and all, and is the record; every other field is parsed from it and loses to it.

`form` is the narrator's name as this line prints it, case ending included. It is read on this leaf and on no other: the same narrator is printed several ways (Ајӈа̀нвáт with and without its grave, once with ӄ, once with н), and carrying one leaf's reading to another would be inferring a glyph from a neighbouring page.
`narrator` groups records under one person. The grouping, the heading `name` (a nominative the book mostly does not print) and every `jesup` correspondence are editorial, at #llm.

`where.place` is an English label; `where.entity` links the shared encyclopedia where an entry exists and is null otherwise, never minted here. The Anyui fair is left unlinked: place:chukchee-fair sits on the Anadyr, not the Anyui.
Items of Sections I-II with no informant line are listed under `unattributed`; whether they name a source some other way is unchecked.
source.tier1: Every `form` and `name`, and the Chukchi toponyms inside `printed` (Аконајке and its variants), are Tier-1 readings awaiting a human's ratification glyph by glyph. The Russian around them is outside the firewall.

Записано отъ чукчи Ӈырóн'а въ 1896 г. Ӈырóн по происхожденію áнӄаlын т. е. приморскій, жилъ на одномъ стойбищѣ съ Олькой Казановымъ, русскимъ мѣщаниномъ, который выросъ среди чукочъ. Здѣсь Олька названъ Тáйӈа-аáчек. Въ лѣто 1892 года они упустили стадо благодаря своей небрежности и все лѣто отыскивали его. Ӈырóн во время этого отыскиванія имѣлъ рядъ откровеній изъ внѣшняго міра (нарһынеwáјпу), которыя сдѣлали его шаманомъ.
